title: The Double Headed Stack Allocator
summary: This article explores a memory allocation technique called the 'double headed stack allocator', which manages memory by allocating from both ends of a pre-allocated buffer simultaneously. The technique is particularly useful in game development and real-time systems where memory allocation performance and efficient bulk deallocation are critical.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of inefficient memory allocation and deallocation overhead in performance-critical applications by providing fast, cache-friendly memory management with O(1) allocation and instant bulk deallocation.
why_valuable: It provides a practical, high-performance memory allocation pattern that eliminates fragmentation issues and allocation overhead common in traditional malloc/free approaches, making it ideal for game engines and real-time rendering systems.
